params.prompt:
Create an exciting, fun, polished 5-second square social ad video using the provided roofing 1APP ad creative as the exact starting frame and the provided 1APP logo as the brand reference. Preserve the original ad layout, real 1APP logo, colors, AI voice UI card, roofer, roof, headline, subtext, CTA button, and all existing text exactly as shown. All text must remain crisp, readable, and stable for the entire video.

Fun motion direction: energetic “never miss a call” lead-capture vibe. Add subtle blue/gold soundwave pulse on the AI voice card, soft sparkle sweep over the CTA, gentle parallax between roofer/roof/UI, and a clean push-in. Keep all typography locked and sharp. Do not invent or change text. Do not add new words, fake letters, extra buttons, warped logos, strange hands, extra fingers, distorted rooflines, or mutated UI. No cuts, no scene changes, no audio.
